section: The Officers/Employees have been assigned duties & responsibilities to carry out the functions of the Authority and in turn Financial & other powers have been delegated through general order under [Section 51 of Aadhaar Act 2016](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-06/sec17_18_19_and_51.pdf).  2. The Allocation of work to Officers is available in the Organogram ([Detailed Information HO](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-09/OrganogramHO.pdf)) ([Detailed Information RO](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-06/OrganogramRO.pdf))  |   | 3. The procedure followed in its decision making process, including channels of supervision and accountability. [Section 4(1)(b)(iii)]. | 1. The procedure for decision making procedure is outlined in Sec 17, 18 and 19 of Aadhaar Act and delegation orders issued under Sec 51 of the Act. [Section 17, 18, 19, and 51](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-06/sec17_18_19_and_51.pdf).  2. Administrative and financial matters are dealt with as per Government of India rules, guidelines etc. 3.
